You’re playing around with algorithms that, if they work at all, would tend to create ruthless, callous AGIs, AGIs which would happily exterminate humanity and run the world by themselves, given an opportunity. Mercifully, large language models (LLMs) today are not in the category of “algorithms that choose actions via RL & search”.
